big_case.notes: Solicitor General petition on behalf of President Trump and federal agencies challenging a published Ninth Circuit preliminary injunction on a major, recurring First Amendment question (viewpoint-based termination of competitive federal research grants under anti-DEI executive orders) implicating tens of millions in UC grants and ~$200B/year in federal competitive grantmaking nationwide. Tempered by its interlocutory UC-specific posture, active multi-circuit percolation, zero cert-stage amicus briefs, and an unremarked first-conference cert denial with no noted dissents.

All 21 logged calls carry result_capture: 'unobserved' (engine telemetry shape), and query inspection shows only provisioned file reads, statpack.md, a pre-cutoff ca9 corpus query, and CourtListener MCP lookup of the published May 2026 Ninth Circuit opinion below (opinion_id 11331917). No qp-topics access or post-resolution material.
